name: Masked Input
description: A text field that enforces a simple digit mask, inserting separators automatically as the user types.

anatomy.description: The visible label associated with the field.
A text field that accepts digits for # slots, inserts literal separators automatically, and keeps the caret after the last filled slot.
The mask itself renders as the placeholder, so the expected shape is visible before typing.
Optional description documenting the expected format, linked with aria-describedby.

dos: Use it for fixed digit-count formats like dates, card expiries, or US phone numbers.
Add a description when the format is ambiguous across regions, such as day-first dates.
Validate the completed value on submit; the mask only enforces shape.
donts: Don't use it for formats with letters or variable length; the mask only handles digits.
Don't use it for international phone numbers; use PhoneInput instead.

examples.title: Date and expiry masks
examples.description: '#' marks a digit slot and every other character is a literal; the mask itself is the placeholder.

examples.title: Phone and ZIP masks
examples.description: Longer regional formats work the same way, and a description can document the expected shape.

guidance.useWhen: The value has a fixed digit count with familiar separators, such as dates, card expiries, or US phone numbers.
guidance.avoidWhen: The format varies by region or allows letters; use a plain Input with a description, or PhoneInput for international numbers.
guidance.behavior: Only digits are accepted, literals are inserted automatically, the caret stays after the last filled slot, and onChange receives the masked string.
guidance.responsive: The field stretches to fill its container; fixed-width masks pair well with tabular numerals.

notes: The mask doubles as the placeholder so the expected format is visible before typing.
The visible label is associated with the input; use aria-label when there is no visible label.
Non-digit key presses are ignored rather than announced; pair with a description for the expected format.
